name: C2 ECO preview for Update PCB
description: Slice C2 (ADR-0041, ADR-0042): the toolbar's Update PCB opens a review of the engine's read-only sync preview instead of applying the sync directly. On an isolated software fixture with two placed parts, the dialog lists the two footprints to add. With nothing checked Apply is refused with the reason; with one footprint unchecked Apply offers the other one alone, and Export report saves the engine's preview as evidence. Apply then sends only the checked change (SyncSchematicToPcbSelected in one Batch) and the Update PCB report shows the one footprint the engine added; a second Update PCB lists only the change left unchecked. Cancel, then one Edit > Undo takes the partial apply back (one undo step): Update PCB lists both footprints again. With every change checked Apply runs the full sync and the report shows both added; a further Update PCB finds nothing to change. Refusals of stale or inconsistent selections are covered by crates/eak-runtime/tests/selective_sync.rs, the row-to-change mapping by src/shell/ecoPreview.test.tsx.
